notes.title: v1.4.5
notes.notes:
[p]Major patch time! This one was focused on some very glaring immersion-breaking issues. Also managed to do a tad bit more polishing and general QOL improvements!

- Updated the encoding on all video files to be VP8, so now they should properly play while using a Steam Deck 
[i]Note: The game is not optimized for the Steam Deck, so any reported framerate issues can't be resolved. Sorry :([/i][/p][p][/p][p]- Made the back wall of the warehouse no longer disappear when the chase starts[/p][p][/p][p]-Made the camera properly collide with the back wall of the warehouse

- Optimized the crate model in the warehouse for better FPS

- Fixed an issue in the main menu intro cutscene that caused the black screen to sometimes fade out before the game fully loaded, resulting in the intro cutscene model being shown again when it shouldn't be

- The intro cutscene now also properly fades out to the chapter card at the right time

- introduced the abilitly to toggle an FPS counter(toggle is located in the additional video settings screen)[/p]

notes.title: v1.4.4
notes.notes: [p]This update was primarily focused on addressing some issues that were currently bothering me. Hopefully, these are good QOL changes all around!  [/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed the elevator light shining through the floor on lower resolutions[/p][p]- Fixed the fullscreen bug where the game wouldn't launch at a proper resolution[/p][p]- Made the jumpscare render on a separate layer so it no longer gets obscured by surrounding objects [/p][p]- Updated the game icon logo for consistency [/p][p]- Fully synced up the intro cutscene visuals to the sounds[/p][p]- Further tweaked the camera for a better UX[/p]

notes.title: v1.4.3
notes.notes:
Another update! Im tempted to make this the final one, but I may give it another few weeks before making the full final update

Fixes/Changes: 

- FULLY fixed the black screen fade in/out happening twice in the manager sector scare cutscene

- Fixed some elevator logic that caused the elevator door to remain open for too long

- Did a tiny bit more optimizing(not much else I can do at this point)

- Added some camera damping and other enhancements to improve the camera controls

- Made the sounds in the beginning cutscene sync up with the visuals a bit more (may do some future tweaking if I notice the sound desyncing too much)

notes.title: Release v1.3.7
notes.notes:
A fresh new update right after release? You got it! What indie game isn't complete without a game-breaking bug at launch? Anywho, I fixed those up, and now it should be good to go! 

-Fixed the last warehouse cutscene breaking the game
 
-Fixed the balance puzzle restart triggers being active upon loading back into the game from the 2nd rod checkpoint 

-Fixed the camera issue that occurs when you stand under the moving warehouse platform

-Polished up a few animations and code logic 

I'll be continuously playtesting the game to squash all the bugs I can for a while, so expect more minor incremental updates and such from here on!
